notes: §2002:13.16.38.3 GR17 symbol meanings, run at --std 2002 on OUTPUT-CD record items under en-US. Z suppresses leading zeros ('  5.25'), 9 always holds a digit ('005.25'), '.' inserts the locale separator and aligns (' 12.50'), '+' signs per the locale ('-$  5.25' de-edits negative), no '+' means unsigned ('$  5.25' de-edits to +5.25), and cs is the locale currency '$'. Every line equals the derivation.
